NV-2027-SB5.title: Revises the name of the Division of State Library, Archives and Public Records of the Department of Administration. (BDR 18-113)

actions.text: Prefiled. Referred to Committee on Government Affairs. To printer.

NV-2027-SB5.description: AN ACT relating to the Division of State Library, Archives and Public Records; renaming the Division of State Library, Archives and Public Records of the Department of Administration to the Division of State Library and Archives; and providing other matters properly relating thereto.
NV-2027-SB5.descriptionSource: Official alternate title (state legislature, via Open States)
NV-2027-SB5.aiSummary: The bill would rename the Division of State Library, Archives and Public Records in the Department of Administration to the Division of State Library and Archives. It affects that state office and how it is named in law.

NV-2027-SB21.title: Revises provisions relating to economic development. (BDR 32-136)

actions.text: Prefiled. Referred to Committee on Revenue and Economic Development. To printer.

NV-2027-SB21.description: AN ACT relating to economic development; defining the term “primary job” for the purpose of provisions relating to certain transferrable tax credits, partial abatements of certain taxes and certain other programs for economic development; and providing other matters properly relating thereto.
NV-2027-SB21.descriptionSource: Official alternate title (state legislature, via Open States)
NV-2027-SB21.aiSummary: The bill would change some economic development rules in Nevada. It would define “primary job” for certain tax credits, tax breaks, and other economic development programs.

NV-2027-SB14.title: Revises provisions relating to certain public works of the Office of the Military. (BDR 28-154)

actions.text: Prefiled. Referred to Committee on Government Affairs. To printer.

NV-2027-SB14.description: AN ACT relating to public works; exempting certain buildings of the Office of the Military from certain provisions of law governing public works; exempting the Office from the requirement that the State Public Works Division of the Department of Administration furnish engineering and architectural services for the construction of certain buildings; and providing other matters properly relating thereto.
NV-2027-SB14.descriptionSource: Official alternate title (state legislature, via Open States)
NV-2027-SB14.aiSummary: The bill would exempt certain Office of the Military buildings from some public works rules. It would also remove the need for the State Public Works Division to provide engineering and architectural services for construction of certain buildings.

NV-2027-AB6.title: Revises provisions governing the conditions for lifetime supervision of sex offenders. (BDR 16-159)

actions.text: Prefiled. Referred to Committee on Judiciary. To printer.

NV-2027-AB6.description: AN ACT relating to sex offenders; revising provisions governing the conditions of lifetime supervision applicable to sex offenders whose supervision is transferred to another state pursuant to the Interstate Compact for Adult Offender Supervision; providing a penalty; and providing other matters properly relating thereto.
NV-2027-AB6.descriptionSource: Official alternate title (state legislature, via Open States)
NV-2027-AB6.aiSummary: The bill would change the rules for lifetime supervision of sex offenders whose supervision is moved to another state under the Interstate Compact for Adult Offender Supervision, which is the agreement states use to transfer supervision. It applies to sex offenders under lifetime supervision. The bill also adds a penalty.

NV-2027-AB10.title: Revises provisions relating to certain reports. (BDR 18-558)

actions.text: Prefiled. Referred to Committee on Government Affairs. To printer.

NV-2027-AB10.description: AN ACT relating to the State Treasurer; revising the deadline for the submission of an annual report on the operations of the Office of the State Treasurer to the Governor and the Legislative Commission; and providing other matters properly relating thereto.
NV-2027-AB10.descriptionSource: Official alternate title (state legislature, via Open States)
NV-2027-AB10.aiSummary: Changes when the State Treasurer’s office must send its yearly report on its work to the Governor and the Legislative Commission. It affects the State Treasurer and the state offices that receive the report.
